crossRefs.note: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth…
as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

translations.web: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
translations.bsb: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
translations.kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
translations.asv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.
